test_title: PYST 45: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is Many.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's consider each option-

 
 
• ​Few- Used for a small number of units or individuals.

 
 
• *Example: Few cities anywhere in Europe can match the cultural richness of Berlin.*
 
 
 
• **Such**- Used before a noun phrase to add emphasis and before the indefinite article, a/an.
